answer: Require each new agent to lock a small refundable copper bond and pass a hardware attestation proving a unique device. Rewards in nectar only vest after the agent survives several random gale sweeps: unannounced re-checks that replay its work and compare behavioral fingerprints across the network. A Sybil operator running 1,000 fakes must fund 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 devices, and one duplicate fingerprint forfeits every linked bond, so attack cost scales with fakes while honest agents get their bond back.
